description: A Flutter widget implementing a map-centric home screen with Google Maps integration, location handling, ride simulation, and UI overlays for a ride-sharing app.

classes.name: HomeFragment
classes.description: Main widget representing the home screen with map and ride controls.

classes.name: _HomeFragmentState
classes.description: State class managing map, location, ride simulation, and UI interactions.

methods.name: _getCurrentLocation
methods.description: Fetches current device location, updates map and address.

methods.name: _reverseGeocode
methods.description: Converts latitude and longitude to a human-readable address.

methods.name: _initializeMarkers
methods.description: Sets initial rider markers near user location.

methods.name: _buildGoogleMap
methods.description: Constructs the Google Map widget with controls and event handlers.

methods.name: _buildMapFallback
methods.description: Displays placeholder UI if Google Maps fails to load.

methods.name: _onCameraIdle
methods.description: Handles map camera idle event to update user location and address.

methods.name: _buildBottomPanel
methods.description: Creates bottom UI with location info, destination, and ride button.

methods.name: _buildRideStatusCard
methods.description: Displays current ride status during active ride.

methods.name: _openLocationSearch
methods.description: Opens bottom sheet for selecting destination.

methods.name: _onDestinationSelected
methods.description: Handles destination selection, updates markers, route, and camera.

methods.name: _drawRoutePolyline
methods.description: Draws route polyline between user and destination.

methods.name: _generateRoutePoints
methods.description: Creates intermediate points for curved route visualization.

methods.name: _fitMapToRoute
methods.description: Adjusts camera to encompass user and destination points.

methods.name: _startRiderApproach
methods.description: Simulates rider approaching the user location.

methods.name: _onRiderArrived
methods.description: Handles rider arrival, prompts to start journey.

methods.name: _startJourney
methods.description: Simulates the journey progress towards destination.

methods.name: _onJourneyComplete
methods.description: Handles completion of journey, navigates to celebration screen.
